caption:
110-SECOND GUIDED INVESTIGATION

Compare the collected fractions. Record purity and rice recovery, then repeat with still air or a different wind. Stronger wind is not automatically a better separation.

Prescribed uniform air; independent reference kernels. Guide 0.9375× model time, manual 1×. Shapes are magnified markers representing 1000 independent kernels each, not physical clumps or measured crop yields. Drag to orbit; scroll to zoom.
